title: Software Engineer III, YouTube Shopping Search, AI
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will design, build, and launch end-to-end generative AI and agentic capabilities that help viewers research, compare, and buy products recommended by creators they trust. Working across the YouTube Shopping and Search stack, you will develop LLM prompts, modular skills, tool integrations (such as live product catalog and affiliate offer retrieval), and interactive shopping UI components (such as product comparison tables, shoppable video indicators, and seamless Search-to-Watch handoffs). You will partner closely with engineers, TLs, PMs, and UX designers across YouTube Shopping and core YouTube Search/Ask teams to take features from rapid prototyping and offline evaluation (Autoraters) to A/B experimentation and global production launch.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Responsibilities

  • Build agentic workflows, modular LLM skills, prompts, and backend tool integrations for conversational responses in live, verified YouTube Shopping product metadata and creator perspectives.
  • Improve the retrieval, ranking, and personalization of shopping results—ensuring shoppable videos and product offers are tailored to user preferences across both Ask YouTube and traditional YouTube Search.
  • Build evaluation pipelines (LLM Autoraters, golden datasets) and run live A/B experiments to optimize answer quality, factuality, latency, and core shopping metrics (such as Shopping DAU and Good Offer Clicks).
  • Collaborate with partner teams across YouTube Search, Ask YouTube, and Shopping Infrastructure, and cross-functional peers in PM and UX, to shape technical designs and deliver outcomes.
  • Design and launch AI shopping experiences on YouTube search and Ask YouTube (together with TLs, PMs, UXDs), including product comparisons, shoppable video treatments, and seamless Search-to-Watch handoffs.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
  • 2 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience developing accessible technologies.
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

title: Product Manager II
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google Display Ads powers the free and open internet, enabling advertisers to reach customers beyond Google owned and operated (O&O) inventory to connect with 90% of the global internet population across millions of websites, videos, CTV and apps. This campaign flexibility allows advertisers to use Google Display Ads (GDA) for brand awareness, website traffic, lead generation, and online sales.

In this role, you will lead a highly visible, critical strategic area for the Google Display Ads business. You’ll shape/develop overall business’ strategy for inventory quality, balancing high-performance and scale with brand-safe, “quality” inventory that advertisers would want to serve into. You will have bidding, invalid traffic (IVT), advertiser controls, reporting, data/signals components and would cover Google Display Network inventory across all Google Ads buying doors .

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the inventory quality strategic area for the business, which key to GDA's future growth.
  • Own overall goal, strategy and execution for GDA Inventory, including defining “high-quality” inventory, strategically solving for inventory we should cut vs. double down on, and improving advertiser and internal perception of the inventory GDA serves into.
  • Act surgically regarding low-quality inventory we are willing to cut for long-term gain, while defining clear success metrics for what the business gains from cutting such inventory.
  • Translate ambiguous advertiser problems into clear next steps, into quantifiable, tangible and concrete solutions.
  • Partner with AdSpam, PMax, Sellside, Engineering, UX and go-to-market (GTM) to ideate and proactively solve for customer issues, with a strong bias for action and pivoting where necessary to land initiatives quickly and effectively.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
  • 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
  • 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
  • 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
  • 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
  • 1 year of experience in technical leadership.

title: Regional Manager, Google Cloud, Government Affairs and Public Policy
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you will be involved in collaborating with Google Cloud and other internal teams to advance Google’s Cloud business and technical infrastructure needs, leading government affairs and public policy matters within key state and local markets. You will serve as Google Cloud's representative to state policymakers, government executives, IT decision makers, and key third-party groups in your markets. A crucial aspect of this position is working with Google Cloud stakeholders to support business growth and public policy objectives at the state and local levels, proactively addressing both risks and opportunities. You will also engage with key trade associations vital for advancing Google Cloud’s public policy, infrastructure and business goals.

Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $181000 - $247000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and lead Google Cloud's policy and government affairs strategy for assigned regional states.
  • Manage and coordinate a network of agreement lobbyists and public affairs firms to advance proactive policy engagement.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with governors’ offices, state legislators, local elected officials, state agencies, local permitting authorities, and trade associations.
  • Shape and advance the company’s positions on key issues, including government procurement, energy, tax policy, permitting, and infrastructure development. Track and analyze legislation, regulation, and local policy trends that could affect the company’s operations, investment, or growth.
  • Partner with internal technical teams and external upstream and downstream stakeholder groups to advance technical infrastructure needs for our users and customers, ensuring a unified approach regarding economic, social and environmental benefits of Google Cloud investments in new and existing markets.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience working on technology policy issues within government, industry, think tanks, public interest groups, law, or relevant industry associations.
  • Experience within state and local government.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience leading or supporting cross-functional teams to deliver economic development projects, including navigating site selection, permitting and community engagement in heavy industrial sectors.
  • Experience with government procurement processes.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% as needed.

title: Industry Manager, Video, YouTube, Retail, Large Customer Sales
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, agencies, and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives and successful collaboration.
  • Lead the execution of strategies to drive adoption, business generation, and strategy for YouTube - leveraging digital marketing tools and platforms to optimize client advertising efforts.
  • Guide clients in leveraging their Intellectual Property (IP) to secure Global Branding leadership on YouTube, accelerating their transition from traditional media to digital, and driving bottom-line growth globally.
  • Overcome strict performance/Return On Advertisement Spending (ROAS) guardrails with Retail/eCommerce customers by partnering with Measurement and Analytical Leads to prove the full-funnel business impact of YouTube.
  • Deploy Geo-based Incrementality Experiments (GeoX), Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Engaged View Conversions (EVCs), and Brand/Search Lift studies to bridge the gap between upper-funnel brand building and lower-funnel Store Visits.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of industry experience in digital advertising, consultative sales, business development, or digital marketing, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • Experience working with advertisers, agencies, or clients.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in video media planning (Linear TV, OTT/CTV, digital video) leveraging metrics like Reach, Frequency, GRPs, Incremental Reach, and CPM/CPA.
  • Experience selling TV or OTT advertising at major broadcasters/platforms or leading integrated video planning at media agencies.
  • Experience managing CPG/FMCG clients with brand-building, reach, and MMM familiarity alongside E-Commerce or Consumer Tech advertisers.
  • Track record of owning growth targets, negotiating annual media commitments or Joint Business Plans (JBPs), and driving Share of Wallet with enterprise clients and agencies.
  • Understanding of the Creator and Influencer ecosystem, short-form vertical video, social commerce, and performance solutions.

title: Technical Strategy and Governance Lead, Vendor Enablement
descriptionHtml:
As the Vendor Strategy and Governance Lead, you will be responsible for defining, implementing, and overseeing the strategy and governance framework for our external vendors and extended workforce within Core Product Area. Your primary goal will be to drive vendor efficiencies, achieve cost savings, reduce operational and co-employment risks, and cultivate strong, strategic partnerships with key suppliers. You will play a critical role in ensuring that our vendor engagements are safe, secure, compliant, and deliver maximum value to Google. You will act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, navigating complex supplier engagements in alignment with Extended Workforce Solutions (xWS) and the Global Procurement Organization (GPO).

At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $128000 - $187000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to discuss extended workforce needs, engaging closely with them to develop solutions, translate requirements into strategic plans, and drive key outcomes and analyzing industry best practices to develop tailored category strategies that enable stakeholders.
  • Build resilient vendor ecosystems through strategic consolidation, optimal location planning, and performance governance, fostering high-performing supplier relationships that are deeply integrated with and accountable to our business goals.
  • Design, implement, and maintain vendor governance and communication frameworks, defining rules of engagement between Googlers and vendor teams to ensure disciplined communication protocols and rigorously mitigate co-employment risks.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with vendor engagements, including data security, privacy, access management, and regulatory compliance, while ensuing adherence to Google's extended workforce standards and policies.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience managing operational projects, agreement negotiations and vendor relationships.
  • Experience developing and implementing vendor governance, compliance, or risk mitigation frameworks.
  • Experience leading cross-functional programs and managing stakeholders without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA or Master's degree in a technical or engineering field.
  • Knowledge of product development, manufacturing processes and supply chain management.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, and the ability to maintain good relationships with stakeholders and suppliers.

title: Customer Engineer, Advanced Technology, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

In this role, you will partner with technical business teams to highlight our platform to clients. You will serve as the domain authority on advanced cognitive systems beyond simple chat interfaces to building secure and data-connected applications. You will engage with clients to map their requirements and present platform value. You will blend market insight to demonstrate our portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical win for workloads within Gemini Enterprise to ensure adoption, supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp. Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution on Google Cloud.
  • Combine business strategies with direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
  • Provide technical consultation to customers on enterprise intelligent systems integration patterns, acting as a technical advisor and building customer relationships.
  • Work with Google Cloud products to demonstrate and prototype integrations in customer and partner environments. Work within Product and Engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
  • Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with cloud-native architecture in a customer-facing or support role, with application development and integration.
  • Experience with search systems including retrieval, ranking, and search quality tuning.
  • Experience with presenting to technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
  • Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.
  • Experience in architecting solutions that integrate computational models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with functional evaluation metrics used to assess model quality and agent quality.
  • Experience with iPaaS, API gateways, or enterprise service buses (ESBs) in a cloud environment.
  • Experience developing automated orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or enterprise software development kits.
  • Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for intelligent software solutions.
  • Knowledge of application integration governance and security, including open authorization 2.0 (OAuth2) flows and short-lived credential management.
  • Understanding integration patterns using OpenAPI and model context protocol (MCP) to connect autonomous software entities with business systems and API gateways.

title: Program Manager, Transformation, AI2
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

In AI2, we strive to empower our customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. In joining us, you’d thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment where your technical expertise and program management skills will directly impact Google's AI strategy.

If you have a passion for AI and Infrastructure, a proven track record of managing complex programs, and driving audacious outcomes, we want to hear from you. You'll join the AI and Infrastructure Programs team to drive large scale transformation across the organization. You will mobilize cross-functional teams, deliver solutions for scale, and drive data-driven decision making to deliver a sustainable program that supports and accelerates the transformation of the AI and Infrastructure organization.
In this role, you will solve challenging business and engineering problems and contribute leadership and experience managing across disciplines to produce results in a timely manner. You will drive execution of cross-cutting, complex programs and actions to closure, resolve problems and gain alignment, identify trends, determine improvement areas, and implement change.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $188000 - $274000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the planning and implementation of complex and strategic transformational programs, working closely with leaders across multiple functions.
  • Establish transformational program vision and direction by developing program roadmaps, schedules, and milestones.
  • Leverage domain expertise to improve product development and business processes, accelerating program execution and efficiency across the portfolio.
  • Manage communications on progress, dependencies, risks, and issues to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Own and nurture relationships between cross-functional teams to proactively anticipate and resolve execution issues.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in program or project management.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence/machine learning projects, tools, or infrastructure.
  • Experience in planning, change management, or process consulting.
  • Experience in product lifecycle management or finance.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience managing large, complex, cross-functional, or cross-team projects.
  • Experience in product development, consulting, technical program management, operations, or supply chain in the technology industry.
  • Experience developing technology or operational strategies and translating strategies into program and project plans.
  • Experience partnering with executive leaders on cross-functional projects.

title: Strategic Partner Onboarding and Incubation Specialist, GRCN, Sellside Monetization (Mandarin, English)
descriptionHtml:
As a Strategic Partner Onboarding and Incubation Specialist, you will be the foundational growth engine for Google’s next generation of sell-side partners across Greater China (GRCN). You will take ownership of high-potential app developers, gaming studios, web publishers, and emerging content platforms during their most pivotal phase—their initial six-month onboarding and incubation window.

This is not a traditional support role. You will combine flawless, detail-obsessed operational execution (account verification, policy compliance, SDK/tag setup, payment plumbing) with sharp commercial instincts to graduate emerging accounts into scaled, long-term strategic powerhouses.

Critically, we are building an intelligent systems incubation engine: you will actively use cutting-edge LLMs, agentic workflows, and prompt engineering to automate repetitive operational tasks, craft smarter troubleshooting tools, and maximize your personal efficiency. Outstanding performers in this role will have a direct career runway into Tier-1 Strategic Partner Management.

The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product-enabling partnerships, go-to-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.

Responsibilities

  • Guide high-growth sellside partners across mobile, web, and new media through their critical initial lifecycle by setting growth milestones and optimizing ad placements.
  • Flawlessly execute end-to-end technical setups—including account creation, SDK integration, and policy audits—ensuing a seamless partner onboarding experience.
  • Leverage creative computational modeling and custom workflows to automate routine tasks, diagnose errors, and significantly boost team operational bandwidth.
  • Act as a trusted business generation advisor to optimize partner unit economics and collaborate with advertiser teams for cross-funnel growth opportunities.
  • Monitor market trends and channel partner feedback to product and gTech teams to proactively advocate for Greater China developers.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Marketing, Communications, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1 year of experience in account management, customer onboarding, digital ad operations, tech consulting, or in a tech startup environment.
  • Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with digital business generation mechanics across AdMob, Google Ad Manager (AdX), AdSense, or Mediation/Bidding networks (AppLovin MAX, Unity, ironSource).
  • Knowledge of mobile games, consumer apps, short-video/drama trends, digital culture, and emerging tech platforms.
  • Exceptional operational discipline and detail orientation—able to handle granular administrative/compliance tasks with high focus, quality, and ownership.
  • Ability to generate advanced patterns and to build custom GPTs, prompts, scripts, or agentic workflows.
  • Ability to be resourceful, resilient solve problems, and think critically, thrive in ambiguity, and ask probing questions.
  • Excellent storytelling skills, with ability to build rapport with various partner stakeholders.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Generative AI, Google Cloud (English)
descriptionHtml:
As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. You will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
  • Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for engineering teams.
  • Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption. Translate technical concepts to non-technical and executive Mandarin-speaking audiences.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development using Python or related coding languages.
  • Experience taking production-grade AI solutions from conception to launch for customers.
  • Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
  • Ability to communicate in English fluently in order to engage clients in the region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Experience leading technical discovery sessions.
  • Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM)-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Engineering Manager, Classroom Mobile Platform Team
descriptionHtml:
Google plays an important role in education around the world – with hundreds of millions of students using Classroom, Workspace, Chromebooks, YouTube, and more. At Google Classroom, we have an incredible opportunity to transform teaching and learning at scale for our 150M+ customers!

Google Classroom is a learning platform that streamlines assignments, boosts collaboration, and fosters seamless communication between instructors and students. Classroom aims to be the simplest and most efficient way for any educator to manage, measure, and drive student learning outcomes.

The Classroom Mobile Platform team's mission is to build a reliable, accessible, and well-crafted experience that empowers users from any background to learn and teach on mobile.

Google Classroom's mobile applications are built primarily in Flutter and Dart. The Mobile Platform team is dedicated to making every aspect of this development process easy, fast, and effective. We collaborate directly with feature teams to understand their needs, investing in initiatives that align with our broader organizational priorities. Today, we are at an exciting inflection point where GenAI is poised to drive a step-change in teaching and learning—and our platform is helping make that happen.

As the team's manager, you will be working with both engineering and cross-functional partners to lead and guide key investments and infrastructure projects. You will guide and coach a talented team of mobile engineers, ensuring that the team is working on the most important priorities while encouraging creativity and innovation in these exciting and dynamic times.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and coach the Classroom Mobile Platform engineering team of about 8.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to the team as they design and build new software systems.
  • Partner with technical leads and managers from partner engineering teams to ensure that we are working effectively together to land key topline metrics and organization goals.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in user research, design, and product to understand educators’ needs, and to translate them into the right technical decisions and systems.
  • Maintain a healthy and effective team culture for your team and partner teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degreeor equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 3 years of experience with full stack development, across the back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience building and maintaining effective, collaborative engineering teams.
  • Experience with one of our core languages: Dart, Java, Swift.
  • Experience working with and learning from a cross-functional team of collaborators including engineers, product managers, and user experience designers and researchers.
  • Knowledge of educational technology, at either the elementary or higher education levels.

title: Technical Solutions Development Manager, Workspace, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Workspace Delivery Manager, you will serve as the primary customer interface for Google Workspace implementations, overseeing deployment strategy, optimization, and service delivery pipelines for enterprise clients. You will leverage your technical expertise, coordinate among developers, sales, partners, and clients to ensure seamless transitions, drive adoption, and maintain high customer satisfaction.

You will lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from inception to completion, defining requirements, managing schedules, and mitigating risks. In this critical role, you will help customers transform their collaboration and communication while leading a team of technical consultants and developers to successfully deliver Google Workspace solutions.

descriptionHtml:

We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

title: Data Center Manager
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As a Hardware Operations Manager, you will manage a team of Data Center Technicians. You will oversee the quality installation of server hardware and components and take charge of complicated installations/troubleshooting.

Your team will install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). They will also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. They may lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

  • Maintain, monitor, and execute security and operational procedures and track/analyze trends to identify opportunities for improvements ensuring alignment with organizational policies.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Ecosystems, Frontier AI, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
As a Product Manager at DeepMind, you will be responsible for shipping AI research breakthroughs into Google’s AI models, products, and open ecosystems. As a Product Manager on Frontier AI within DeepMind, you will be working with AI researchers who are focused on making advances across new model architectures, AGI, and applications like Agents and Robotics. As the Product Manager for AI Ecosystems within Frontier AI, your job will be to guide the strategy and execution across our open-weight models specialized variants (such as the broader Gemmaverse ecosystem) as well as our open interactive training environments, agent harnesses, and privacy-preserving evaluation sandboxes.


You will understand how frontier research breakthroughs can be translated into ecosystems of open AI systems and creating an impactful two-way flywheel between the global open-source community and Google’s core foundation models like Gemini and Gemma. You will help research teams navigate technical, safety, and ecosystem tradeoffs, build collaborations with core model development teams, and partner with Google product areas (such as Cloud, Android, Pixel, and Search) as well as external developers, enterprises, academic researchers, and public-sector institutions to address real-world needs across on-device AI, sovereign and regulated workflows, scientific discovery, and societal benefit. In addition to shipping open-weight model variants, training recipes, and interactive environments, you will build the developer tooling, open-source runtime integrations, and communication strategy so that our open AI systems achieve widespread adoption and set the industry standard.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

title: Director, Strategy and Business Operations, Modular Infrastructure, Global Data Centers
descriptionHtml:
The Modular Manufacturing & Integration organization is leading an industry-defining transformation in how Google delivers technical infrastructure for the AI era. Transitioning away from conventional, on-site, purpose-built civil construction, our mission is to industrialize data center delivery through mass-assembled, standardized modules and off-site manufacturing.

By shifting labor-intensive assembly, systems integration, and quality testing upstream into controlled factory environments, we enable rapid "square wave" capacity delivery—bringing gigawatt-scale AI compute, liquid cooling, power distribution, and network fabric into productive service with unprecedented velocity upon site arrival. Operating across AI Systems & Infrastructure (AI2), Google Data Centers (GDC), Systems & Manufacturing (ISM), and Google Global Infrastructure (GGI), our team defines the modular technical product and serves as the accountable business owner for industrializing and landing modular capacity globally.

As the Director of Strategy & Business Operations, you will serve as the chief operating strategist, business architect, and executive integrator for Google’s Modular Manufacturing & Integration organization. In this founding leadership role, you will be the first hire dedicated to strategy and business operations, initially operating with high personal leverage and subsequently recruiting and leading a specialized Strategy & BizOps team as the organization scales.

You will bridge the gap between Google's multi-year technical vision and pragmatic cross-organizational execution. You will hold executive business ownership of modular unit economics, capital velocity, and product cost targets—partnering closely with Corp Strategy and Finance while steering the business narrative.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Infrastructure Finance to design sophisticated Total Cost of Ownership (PerfTCO) frameworks, quantifying the enterprise balance-sheet value of accelerated capacity deployment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Data Cloud, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud’s Data Cloud team builds the data platform behind Google’s agentic AI offerings: BigQuery, Managed Spark, borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB and Knowledge Catalog, integrated with Gemini Enterprise.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on the Data Cloud team, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier data solutions and production-grade reality for customers. You will function as an "innovator-builder," working directly within customers’ environments to move data and machine learning workloads from idea to production on Google Cloud, leveraging experience with programming languages (e.g. PySpark, SQL, Python) and the data cloud ecosystem (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB). You will build the data foundations that agents depend on, and train and evaluate machine learning models on customer data. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Build and ship production data and machine learning workloads with customers, writing, testing, and performance-tuning PySpark, SQL and Python on BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner and AlloyDB.
  • Present working proofs with customers’ data, including de-identifying sensitive data (e.g., PCI, PHI).
  • Build the data foundation for agentic solutions, including lakehouse architectures, metadata, semantic context, and the access controls that let custom agents act on trusted data.
  • Train, evaluate and deploy machine learning and agentic components where they improve the customer’s business metric, with evaluation and monitoring in place.
  • Refactor and migrate high-cost analytics, Spark and operational database workloads from other platforms onto Google Cloud engines, with measured price-performance results.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, machine learning, or technical consulting, including coding experience in Python and SQL.
  • Experience with data cloud ecosystem products, technologies, or languages (e.g., Apache Spark, PySpark, BigQuery, Spanner, Data Catalog, and AlloyDB).
  • Experience taking production-grade data cloud solutions from conception to launch, including architecting data systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP) and building structured/unstructured pipelines.
  • Experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Knowledge of large language model (LLM)-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
  • Experience in prompt developing, model evaluation, and the creative application of AI.
  • Experience building applications on LLM over enterprise data (e.g., Gemini, agents, RAG, vector search) and evaluating them for quality, latency and cost.
  • Experience migrating analytics, Spark or database workloads between platforms with measured cost or performance outcomes.

title: Senior Silicon Design Verification Engineer, YouTube Video Accelerators
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a part of the Design Verification (DV) role in the Argos IP team, you will ensure the functional correctness of custom video codec ASICs for YouTube by managing a specialized High-Level Synthesis (HLS) workflow that requires verification at both the C/C++ and RTL levels. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between algorithmic intent and hardware implementation, employing a hybrid strategy that includes C++ software testing, C/RTL co-simulation, and traditional SystemVerilog/ Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) testbenches to guarantee equivalence and compliance. Your role demands comprehensive ownership of the verification life-cycle, from architectural planning and mixed-abstraction debugging to final coverage closure, while continuously refining methodologies to handle the specific complexities of HLS-based silicon design.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead comprehensive verification strategies and signoff for complex blocks where the source is C/C++, taking full ownership of quality from HLS code to generated RTL.
  • Design and maintain advanced environments, including C/C++ GoogleTest for functional validation and SystemVerilog/UVM for RTL timing and system interactions.
  • Employ HLS-specific methods such as C/RTL co-simulation, formal equivalence verification, and transaction-level modeling to ensure hardware fidelity.
  • Drive complex bug hunting and coverage analysis across both C++ and RTL domains to ensure complete verification of the design transformation.
  • Partner with design teams to optimize C++ code for verifiability and mentor junior engineers on the nuances of HLS verification.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with Design Verification.
  • Experience with SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Practical experience with High-Level Synthesis tools (e.g., Catapult, Vivado, XLS) and strong C/C++ skills for developing HLS testbenches and models.
  • Expertise in video processing, image pipelines, or video compression standards such as AV1, AV2, or H.264.
  • Demonstrated ability to debug complex issues across C/C++ and RTL levels using industry-standard EDA tools like VCS, Xcelium, or Verdi.

title: Wafer Bonding Process Engineer, Quantum AI
descriptionHtml:
Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications.

In this role, you will lead the development, integration, and Release to Production of temporary wafer bonding, thinning, and debonding (TB/DB) processes for Google Quantum AI’s next-generation quantum processors. Responsibilities include developing and implementing process flows featuring advanced adhesive bonding chemistries, manufacturable debonding systems, and thin-wafer handling. You will partner with equipment vendors and cleanroom module owners to bring up automated bonding and debonding equipment, coordinate evaluation runs, and transition validated processes into baseline process flows for upcoming milestones. You will establish robust process controls to mitigate wafer stress, bow, warp, and other downstream process integration issues across ultra-thin substrates.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, integrate, and transition to production temporary adhesive bonding and laser debond processes and equipment for advanced 3D Integration of quantum devices..
  • Specify, bring up, and qualify required clean room equipment and advanced metrology capabilities, establishing baseline operational recipes and documentation.
  • Drive process integration activities around wafer thinning, thin-wafer handling, and stress/warp mitigation. 
  • Coordinate vendor evaluations, off-site demos, technology transfers, and Release to Production of tools and processes into quantum device production processes.
  • Troubleshoot processing anomalies, improve yield, and train cleanroom personnel and technicians on standard operating procedures.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a specialized field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP, etc.), or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience developing, sustaining, or integrating semiconductor fabrication processes in an research and development (R&D) or cleanroom production environment.
  • 3 years of experience in temporary wafer bonding, laser/thermal debonding, thin wafer handling, or back-end packaging processes.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP).
  • Experience mitigating mechanical stress, bow, warp, and micro-cracking in ultra-thin silicon substrates, integrated with backside thinning and dicing-on-tape workflows.
  • Experience executing 3D Integration technical roadmaps, executing complex development and process integration projects.
  • Excellent collaborative leadership skills, and experience leading technical evaluations with equipment vendors, managing joint development projects, and cross-training/mentoring engineers and technicians.
  • Expertise in polymer adhesives, temporary bonding materials, and release processes.
  • Ownership qualifying automated temporary bonding, lamination, and laser/mechanical debonding tools.

title: Regional Program Manager, Data Center, Front-End-Planning
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple, simultaneous data center site/civil development projects in the due-diligence and master planning to pad ready phases.
  • Be responsible for gathering internal requirements and delivering solutions that satisfy customer needs.
  • Maintain end to end responsibility of large scale utility projects (power, water, sewer, mass grading) from concept, design to construction, while maintaining rigorous adherence to project timelines and costs.
  • Manage large scale utility coordination, as sites grow with capacity needs and manage on-site site/civil construction works.
  • Support special R&D experiments, renovations, and upgrades as it impacts utilities, within matrix organization.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program management.
  • 5 years of experience managing multi-group, multi-disciplinary construction projects.
  • 2 years of experience with electrical and mechanical systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Construction Management or related technical fields.
  • 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • 5 years of relevant work experience with data center master planning and utility projects.
  • Experience managing multiple A&E firms for rapid campus planning and utility trigger table development.
  • Experience working with local utilities to understand existing infrastructure limitations and future capacity upgrades.
  • Experience working with on-site construction management team, kicking off and handing over project for start of construction.

title: Software Engineer, Finance and Growth Platform, Payments
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Consumer Payments Finance and Growth Platform team owns the infrastructure powering payments data processing, growth, engagement, and business generation across Google’s Consumer Payments global business. We provide reliable, high-performance, and scalable solutions for users to have rich financial search and insights, reach users via notifications, emails, in-surface communications, and offer rewards and incentives.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable features and infrastructure for the Finance and Growth platform.
  • Work on all technical aspects of development, including technical requirements definition, design, implementation, unit testing, and integration.
  • Contribute to the architectural evolution of the platform, balancing the needs for centralization vs decentralization.
  • Ensure the performance and reliability of critical services, maintaining high availability standards for global finance back-end infrastructures.
  • Participate in code reviews, share knowledge to foster a culture of technical excellence.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript), or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
  • 1 year of experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI evaluations, training, or models.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) or machine learning systems.
  • Experience developing Generative AI Agentic solutions, LLM integrations, or accessible technologies to improve data exploration and developer productivity.
  • Expertise in distributed systems design, specifically in architecting high-performance services that handle millions of requests per second.

title: Account Strategist, Engage, GCS, DACH Market (German, English)
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Ireland: €76000 - €77500 (EUR) + 35% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Grow small-sized businesses in Germany with significant expansion potential.
  • Establish relationships by conducting regular phone consultations and sales pitches with a large portfolio of clients, using your sales, problem-solving and objection managing skills to operate in a fluid environment, reaching for ambitious business and productivity goals.
  • Deliver effective solutions to high potential small businesses from all verticals and business models, in each stage of their journey, in the most efficient way for the business and with a high performing sales team at scale.
  • Use commercial acumen, to uncover the business needs of Google's key clients and achieve their marketing objectives while generating incremental business goals through our industry leading advertising solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in advertising, consultative sales, business development, online media environment, or marketing role.
  • Ability to communicate in English and German fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Certification in Google Digital Workshop.
  • Experience in strategically assessing and achieving client success via proven sales techniques, including effective discovery questioning, objection handling, and consultative selling.
  • Familiarity with Google Ads and online advertising.
  • Ability to own a portfolio in an advertising or media sales context in German, and consistently overachieve quotas to drive growth.
  • Ability to multi-task and manage multiple projects at a time while paying attention to detail.
  • Ability to build compelling narratives and utilize storytelling as a client engagement strategy, and influence stakeholders internally and externally to deliver impact.

title: Design Team Manager, Servers, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a Design Team Manager within the Server Chip Design team, you will use your ASIC design experience to be part of a team that creates the SoC VLSI design cycle from start to finish. You will collaborate closely with design and verification engineers in active projects, creating architecture definitions with RTL coding, and running block level simulations.

In this role, you will oversee the Intellectual Property (IP) and SoC VLSI design cycle from architecture to production. You will own and manage IP, subsystems and SoC development, leading a group of designers and design tech leads. You will be responsible for mentoring and developing team members and tech leads, driving improvements in leadership, technical execution, and design flows.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of tech leads and designers. Develop and mentor team members, and communicate and co-work with multi-disciplined and multi-site teams.
  • Lead design activities at IP’s, subsystems, and System-on-Chips (SoCs).
  • Plan, execute, track progress, assure quality, and report status of the assigned activity.
  • Work closely with internal customers and support multiple activities and deliverables.
  • Assure and manage deliverables quality at all RTL design categories including reviews, static checks, design for physical design, power, etc.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in RTL design cycle from IP to SoC, from specification to production.
  • 8 years of experience in execution teams management.
  • Experience in the following areas: RTL design, design quality checks, physical design aspects of RTL coding, and power.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with synthesis techniques to optimize Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code, performance and power as well as low-power design techniques.
  • Experience with a scripting language like Python or Perl.
  • Experience with design for test and its impact on design and physical design.
  • Knowledge of one of the following areas: PCIe, UCIe, DDR, AXI, CHI, Fabrics, ARM processors family.
  • Knowledge of SoC architecture and assertion-based formal verification.
  • Knowledge of high performance and low power design techniques.

title: Silicon Engineer, Power Analysis, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $217000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Architect advanced technology node power solutions and establish use case budgets with block and full-chip estimations.
  • Lead and drive the automation and integration of power analysis processes—including RTL power analysis, optimization, IP selection, physical design, and timing closure—into our automated flow.
  • Apply hardware expertise to build, create, and integrate software components for automated early- and late-stage power analysis and optimization.
  • Partner with systems power and cross-functional teams to define, execute, and advocate for power management and reduction methodologies from SoC architecture through sign-off.
  • Specify requirements for power management IPs while managing their design, integration, and post-silicon validation.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 7 years of experience working in ASIC power analysis & optimization, including experience with production chips
  • Experience in tape-outs of chips
  • Experience interacting and collaborating with silicon foundries and other external vendors for the tapeout process
  • Experience with Verilog and industry-standard EDA tools for power analysis & optimization design (e.g., PP-RTLA, PowerArtist, PrimeTime-PX, PrimeTime, Cadence Innovus, Synopsys Fusion Compiler)
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Perl, Tcl) for automation of power analysis & optimization flows
  • Software development experience

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics or related field

title: Technical Program Manager, Offsite Infrastructure Delivery
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.   • Escalate all project issues to appropriate internal and external stakeholders in a timely manner.

  • 5 years of experience designing, constructing, or managing infrastructure projects.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience interacting with various government and regulatory bodies.
  • Experience in change management and communication strategy.

  • Experience leading large cross-functional teams across multiple internal departments.
  • Excellent problem solving and communication skills, with the ability to construct, articulate, and defend simple messages or insights from analysis.

title: Data Transformation Lead, GCAS (Japanese, English)
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Global marketing done right is becoming more challenging due to fast-changing consumer expectations, changes in individual market landscapes, and the rate of technological change. At its core, Global Clients and Agency Solutions (GCAS) helps leading brands, trade bodies and marketing partners navigate this complexity so that they can continue to be the market makers who positively shape our industry. Everyday, we help our partners fully utilize Google’s products, talent and insights to advance their marketing performance and the advertising ecosystem at large. Whether through building stronger tech and media foundations, surfacing cutting edge insights or structuring industry dialogue, GCAS helps shape what’s next into now.

Responsibilities

  • Drive high adoption of foundational data platforms including GA4, Enhanced Conversions (EC), and Google Tag Gateway (GTG) for global automotive clients.
  • Establish and execute a long-term data strategy and roadmap, ensuring strong data quality through 1PD activation methods such as VBB, Customer Match, and Store Visits.
  • Position Google as a partner of choice for AI transformation, collaborating with Analytical Leads to prove the impact of AI on creative, media, and measurement outcomes.
  • Act as a key technical advisor to business stakeholders, translating complex concepts into clear stories to influence executive sponsors and drive value-centric partnerships.
  • Partner with sales, gTech, and product teams to identify opportunities, remove roadblocks, and modernize data infrastructure for advanced AI solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in media analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, consulting, or financial analysis.
  • Ability to communicate in Japanese and English fluently to interact with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in the automotive sector, managing account transitions and delivering complex digital projects for global clients.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams such as gTech and Cloud to drive business outcomes and remove roadblocks.
  • Deep technical expertise in architecting AI-driven data roadmaps and implementing Google's measurement suite (GA4, EC, GTG).
  • Proven ability to build and maintain value-centric partnerships with C-level stakeholders, driving trust through deep measurement knowledge.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI and data frameworks into actionable business strategies for non-technical audiences.
